body:
I'm a 23-year-old college student constantly looking for ways to make my life a little bit easier. I'd been experimenting with nootropics without much success until yesterday evening. My bottle of Aniracetam arrived in the afternoon and I didn't hesitate to try this substance for the first time. I had a very poor experience with Piracetam, which surprised me with lengthy headaches and feelings of depression. Regardless, my resolve to find an ally for my long-time friend, Adderall, remained. Hoping Aniracetam may be the answer, my night of studying for finals week began.
[T+0:00] I begin my afternoon by taking 400mg of Citicoline, and give it a 60-minute head start, fear of the destructive headaches Piracetam gave me still fresh in my memory.
[T+1:00] I feel normal. I take 15mg of Adderall on an empty stomach. Usually Adderall takes 30 minutes to kick in for me, and Ive decided to wait until then to take aniracetam.
[T+1:30] Im aware the Adderall has taken effect when a mild euphoria sweeps through my body. At this time, I ingest 750mg of Aniracetam.
[T+1:45] Thoughts of how Aniracetam is more potent than piracetam bounce around in my mind, and my anxiety grows to an uncomfortable level. I sit back and put on some relaxing music, telling myself Ill begin studying in 30 minutes.
.
[T+2:15] My anxiety levels have dropped back to normal and Im ready to study the towering pile of flash cards Ive made for my marketing class. Im unsure if the Aniracetam has taken effect, I feel the same as usual. Maybe the Adderall is overpowering it, I tell myself.
Im unsure if the Aniracetam has taken effect, I feel the same as usual. Maybe the Adderall is overpowering it, I tell myself.
Ive read that racetams and Adderall have a synergistic effect, so my high hopes remain. I walk into my office and begin reviewing my study material.
[T+3:15] Im certain that the Aniracetam must be in my system at this point. However, I dont feel any different. I stick with my belief that the Adderall is downplaying any noticeable effect from the Aniracetam.
[T+3:30] Im stunned when I realize that something incredible is taking place. Time and time again, Im able to recite lengthy definitions from memory, after only reviewing terms one or two times. I get distracted thinking about the immeasurable benefit this will have on my life. Any and all studying will take a fifth of the time it did just a few days before if this keeps up.
[T+5:15] At approximately 6:15 in the evening on a Friday night, Ive completed what was supposed to rob me of my entire weekend. Ive no headache, and I feel prepared to ace a challenging final exam after a single night of studying. There were many concepts which just ingrained themselves in my memory, with little to no effort.
[T+6:00] I dont feel any substances in my system at this point, and the Adderall come-down went unnoticed. I attribute this to my overwhelming sense of well-being, knowing how much more time Ill have for recreation, and how my newly gained photographic memory will bring me joy in other areas of my life as well.
Although I cant say much about Aniracetams other reported effects, there is zero doubt in my mind that Ill be partnering Adderall and Aniracetam daily to reap in unlimited amounts of knowledge. Aniracetam has reinvigorated my aspirations to succeed, and I spent the rest of the evening setting my goals higher than I ever thought possible.
